role: Proof suite for SleepResolver: the four-row decision matrix (session+Watch, session only, Watch only, empty), envelope clipping edge cases, AutoSleep back-to-bed and pause/resume merging, cross-source overlap resolution, iPhone early-guess filter, time-in-bed derivation and SleepData time-in-bed repair.
types: SleepResolverTests: class — XCTestCase for SleepResolver and SleepData time-in-bed helpers
state: bedtime: fixed 2026-01-15 22:00 UTC built via TestDate.from
toplevel: The `bedtime` stored-property initializer builds 2026-01-15 22:00 UTC with a Gregorian calendar via TestDate.from (EmuquTests/TestDate.swift:17).

Returns (anchor ?? bedtime) + offsetMinutes minutes.

Builds a SleepResolver.Context with the given bounds/samples/RR/enhance/extension, bedtime window 22–06, fallbackDate bedtime and splitGapMinutes 20.
